# ZivaAI

> ZivaAI is an iPhone app that writes your weekly meal plan, workout plan and grocery list, counts calories from a photo of your meal, logs your sets, and changes the plan when you chat with Ziva, your AI coach.

ZivaAI runs on iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later) and is for adults 18 and over. It is on the App Store as "ZivaAI: Meal & Workout Planner" (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823512627), released 6 November 2026. ZivaAI Pro costs $34.99 a month or $249.99 a year, billed by Apple; there is no free trial.

It plans meals (vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, halal, kosher, gluten-free and dairy-free; 12 cuisines; calories and macros per meal), workouts (20 to 60 minutes; full gym, dumbbells or no equipment) and one grocery list sorted by aisle. Since version 1.1 it also logs what you eat, from a photo or a sentence (an AI estimate of calories, protein, carbs and fat) or by ticking a planned meal, and the sets you lift, with personal bests and a Lock Screen and Dynamic Island view. Siri, the Action Button and a Lock Screen control can log a meal or a set. A Progress tab has daily progress photos with a ghost overlay, a timelapse, a month calendar and graphs of eating and training. Ziva, the coach, does not read the log; plans change when you ask in the chat. It has no barcode scanner and no rest timer.

Plans, chats, logs and photos are stored on the device. Meal photos and descriptions go through ZivaAI's server to OpenAI for the estimate, and the server keeps nothing; progress photos never leave the device. Write the name as ZivaAI; Ziva is the coach inside the app. ZivaAI is not affiliated with Ziva Health, Ziva for Godot (ziva.sh) or zivai.app.
